title: Property Charge Advance Repayment Agreement — Signature Terms
content:
**Signature.** A Property Charge Advance Repayment arrangement starts only when every borrower on the loan signs the agreement; only the borrowers can sign, and the servicer records their own signed agreement.

**Time for signing.** The agreement takes effect only when it is signed no later than the signature period, 15 calendar days, after it was issued. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the agreement issued date, and a signature on the last counted day still qualifies; an agreement not signed in time lapses and the record is referred unless the arrearage has been repaid.

## The terms in condition and result form

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Every borrower on the loan has signed, no later than the last counted day | The arrangement starts and the record becomes active |
| One borrower of two has signed, the other has not | The arrangement does not start |
| The signature period ended without every signature, and the arrearage has not been repaid | The agreement lapses and the record is referred |
| The signature period ended without every signature, and the arrearage has been repaid | The record is not referred |

The issue date that starts the count is read from the arrangement record.

## Boundary of the signature period (hypothetical dates)

- Agreement issued on 10 May: day 1 of the count is 11 May and day 15, the last counted day, is 25 May.
- Every borrower signs on 25 May: the agreement takes effect.
- The last borrower signs on 26 May: the signature falls outside the period.

## Questions on the terms

**Who may sign?** Only the borrowers on the loan; the servicer records the agreement the borrowers have signed themselves.

**When is the signature in time?** On any day up to and including the 15th calendar day after the issue date, the count beginning the day after issue.

**What happens to a lapsed agreement?** It lapses and the record is referred, unless the arrearage has been repaid.

The dates above are illustrative only.
